title: BC Friday Tips #73 Show All Configuration Package Errors
summary: When applying a Configuration Package in Business Central, users can view all errors on a single page by clicking the Error section, allowing faster review and resolution without checking entries individually.
key_points: Configuration Package errors can be displayed all together on one page
Clicking the Error section opens a dedicated page listing every error
Reviewing all errors at once is faster than checking each entry separately
This feature streamlines the troubleshooting process for package implementations

quotes.text: you can view all Configuration Package errors on a single page
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the core capability that speeds up troubleshooting during package implementation

quotes.text: This makes it much faster to review and fix issues.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the practical benefit of using this feature for efficient problem resolution
